definitions.explanation: A milky-textured skincare product used to moisturize the skin, typically applied after toner in a Japanese skincare routine.
A milky white fluid produced by certain plants, or an emulsion in chemistry.

examples.japanese: {乳液|にゅうえき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}る→塗る：01174_nuru⟧。
⟦{化粧水|けしょうすい}→化粧水：15802_keshousui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{乳液|にゅうえき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I put on moisturizing lotion after toner.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{乾燥|かんそう}→乾燥：00184_kansou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦しっかり→しっかり：01272_shikkari⟧{乳液|にゅうえき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{保湿|ほしつ}→保湿：11617_hoshitsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: It gets dry in winter, so you should moisturize well with lotion.

examples.japanese: ⟦ゴム→ゴム：00073_gomu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{乳液|にゅうえき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{採取|さいしゅ}→採取：12901_saishu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To extract latex from a rubber tree.

examples.japanese: ⟦{植物|しょくぶつ}→植物：03248_shokubutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{茎|くき}→茎：14119_kuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{白|しろ}い→白い：00587_shiroi⟧{乳液|にゅうえき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: A white milky sap came out when I cut the plant's stem.
I remember seeing milky sap seep out when breaking a dandelion stem as a child.

notes:
USAGE:
In everyday use, sense 1 (skincare product) is far more common. Japanese skincare routines typically follow a sequence: ⟦{洗顔|せんがん}→洗顔：21254_sengan⟧ (face wash) → ⟦{化粧水|けしょうすい}→化粧水：15802_keshousui⟧ (toner) → {乳液|にゅうえき} (moisturizing lotion). The botanical/chemical sense (sense 2) appears in scientific texts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {乳液|にゅうえき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}る→塗る：01174_nuru⟧ (to apply lotion)
- {乳液|にゅうえき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧ (to put on lotion)
- ⟦{保湿|ほしつ}→保湿：11617_hoshitsu⟧{乳液|にゅうえき} (moisturizing lotion)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{化粧水|けしょうすい}→化粧水：15802_keshousui⟧: toner, face lotion — a lighter, water-based product applied before {乳液|にゅうえき}
- ⟦クリーム→クリーム：00253_kuriimu⟧: cream — thicker moisturizer, applied after {乳液|にゅうえき}
